source.title: USDA NASS — Vegetables 2024 Summary (February 2025)
source.note: Lettuce — yield_kg_ha: 33,900 kg/ha US national average, 2021–2024. All fresh-market lettuce (head + leaf + romaine) combined by production weight: total production 396.54 million cwt / 1,309,300 harvested acres = 302.9 cwt/acre; × 45.359 kg/cwt ÷ 0.40469 ha/acre (= ×112.085) = 33,946 kg/ha, rounded to 33,900. Yearly: 2021 286.5 cwt/ac, 2022 289.2, 2023 316.9, 2024 321.8. 2022–2024 from Vegetables 2024 Summary (Feb 2025); 2021 revised figures from Vegetables 2023 Summary (Feb 2024, https://esmis.nal.usda.gov/sites/default/release-files/02870v86p/qz20vd735/ht24z584t/vegean24.pdf). 2019–2020 not used because NASS revised the lettuce series upward from 2021 and older years are on the unrevised basis. Fresh harvested weight, same basis as the FAO world value.

source.title: Mekonnen & Hoekstra — Water Footprint of Crops (Report 47)
source.note: Lettuce — water_per_kg: 130 L/kg used (sourced from WFN online crop database). Report 47 Table A1 reports 237 L/kg. The discrepancy reflects different methodologies: Report 47 uses a global production-weighted virtual water model; the WFN online calculator (130 L/kg) applies simplified blue+green accounting. Neither is clearly wrong; the lower figure may reflect the dominant role of intensive irrigation-efficient greenhouse production (particularly in China). Value flagged but not corrected — difference is within methodological range.

source.title: Mekonnen & Hoekstra (2010) — Water Footprint of Crops, Report 47 Vol. 2 (national appendices)
source.note: Lettuce — water_per_kg: 113 L/kg (m3/ton) US national average (Appendix II 'CNTRY-average' column for United States of America, product 070511 lettuce, 1996–2005). US lettuce WF = green 30 + blue 42 + grey 41 = 113 L/kg. Cross-checked against Appendix IV US lettuce volumes (green 128.45, blue 184.44, grey 177.87, total 490.75 Mm3/yr), which divided by ~4.35 Mt/yr US production give the same per-ton values. Total includes grey water (green+blue+grey), per SCHEMA definition and Report 47 totals. Note: the existing world entry (130) is described as green+blue only, so it is not on the same basis; if matched to green+blue, the US value would be 72 L/kg. Same source/basis as the global Report 47 figures (global lettuce: green 133, blue 28, grey 77, total 237 L/kg).
